title: kithctl watch: header read loop has no byte/count limit
description: watch.rs:309-321 and jmap_post:516-531: the HTTP header-reading loop calls read_line in a loop with no limit on header count or total bytes. A server sending an infinite header stream will cause the loop to spin forever. Even for a trusted kithd, defensive coding requires a hard limit (e.g. 100 headers, 64 KiB total). Without it a misbehaving daemon hangs kithctl watch indefinitely.
